notes.claim: A system of three equations is solved by eliminating the same variable in two pairs of equations, leaving two equations in two variables.
The marine engineers' syllabus includes linear simultaneous equations of three unknowns.

sources.title: 4.4 Solve Systems of Equations with Three Variables - Intermediate Algebra 2e | OpenStax
sources.quote: We start with two pairs of equations and in each pair we eliminate the same variable. This will then give us a system of equations with only two variables and then we know how to solve that system!

sources.title: Mathematics Written Examination Syllabus - GOV.UK
sources.quote: 29. Solves linear simultaneous equations of three unknowns.
